card.name: Dense growth of plants and vegetation
card.fires_on: Words that start or sit inside descriptions of dense, tangled plant growth, such as 'thick' (thickly, thickets), 'inter' (interlaced), and 'tangled'. It appears in nature, garden and landscape text.

modes.description: The start of words like thick or inter that describe crowding or weaving together of vegetation or tissue.

card.plain: It fires on words describing thick, tangled or crowded plant growth in nature and garden writing.
